decisions.reason: As a newly launched Magento shop template close to the core hosting and shop offer, it is easy to justify keeping despite only modest public commitment because it complements established customer projects.

The responsive website template is near the firm's existing business but seems only lightly committed on the website, so it is somewhat easier to withdraw than more visible launches yet still likely to be retained.

Premium customer support fits directly with the firm's agency-focused service promise and expert-support positioning, making management inclined to continue it rather than admit a mistaken extension of the core offer.
The software version management tool builds on the established offer and was given its own page, indicating both investment and public commitment that favor persistence.

Although the data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the core business, its own webpage and recent launch create enough visible commitment that management would more likely persist for now than remove it immediately.
